meta.title: Search
meta.description: Adds ten web_search providers (Naver, Kakao, You.com, Parallel, Keenable, Tavily, TinyFish, Jina, Firecrawl, Bing), an automatic engine (auto) and the /search command. Each provider takes an API key on this page; leave it empty to search without a key on a small quota. Naver, Kakao, TinyFish and Jina need a key. Not an official DeepSeek plugin.
